title: DAST sa OWASP ZAP-om
summary: Dinamičko testiranje pokrenute aplikacije OWASP ZAP-om u pipelineu: baseline, full i API skeniranje, automation framework plan, pravila po ID-u, lažni pozitivi i pragovi za pad builda.
summary_en: Dynamic testing of the running application with OWASP ZAP in the pipeline: baseline, full and API scans, an automation framework plan, rules by ID, false positives and build-failure thresholds.
